astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: M82: Galaxy with a Supergalactic Wind
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Why is the Cigar Galaxy billowing red smoke?  M82, as this starburst galaxy is also known, was stirred up by a recent pass near large spiral galaxy M81.  This doesn't fully explain the source of the red-glowing outwardly expanding gas and dust, however.
